what_this_is: The VERIFY-1 read's per-row resolution table: which sealed ROLL-1 Solver sample index sat in which 1-based POSITION of the candidate block the frozen core was shown, plus that row's distinct-answer and parse counts. Model-free: counts, ids, permutations and hashes only. No candidate text, utterance, transcript or gold is persisted, and no flight reads this file -- the wire derives the same permutation from the sealed manifest bytes and the pinned seed.
